name: Can a kitchen addition work on a narrow lot in Burbank or North Hollywood?

mainEntity.name: Can a kitchen addition work on a narrow lot in Burbank or North Hollywood?
mainEntity.text: Can a kitchen addition work on a narrow lot in Burbank or North Hollywood?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, kitchen additions can work on narrow lots in Burbank or North Hollywood, but the design has to be efficient. Narrow-site projects often rely on rear additions, compact bump-outs, or interior reconfiguration instead of large expansions. The biggest challenges are setbacks, side-yard clearance, construction access, drainage, and fitting the new space into the home’s existing roof and structural system. In dense neighborhoods, even getting materials and equipment onto the site can affect the build sequence. Homeowners should also plan for how the addition will connect to existing plumbing, electrical, and HVAC systems without creating awkward chases or wasted space. A narrow lot does not automatically rule out a kitchen addition, but it often requires more creative design and tighter cost control. This question is underserved because most general articles assume standard lots and do not address the constraints of compact urban parcels. The best answer should explain that feasibility depends on layout, setbacks, and whether the project is a true addition or a smarter interior expansion.
